result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.is_strongly_connected()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Check if the graph is strongly connected. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L21495-L21548){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.is_strongly_connected() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} A directed graph is strongly connected if there is a directed path from every node to every other node. Equivalently, the graph has exactly one strongly connected component containing all nodes. For undirected graphs, this is equivalent to checking regular connectivity (same as `is_connected()`). ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : `True` if the graph is strongly connected, `False` otherwise. Empty graphs are considered strongly connected (vacuously true). ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} Time complexity: `O(V + E)` using Kosaraju's algorithm to count SCCs. ## Examples {.doc-examples} In a directed cycle, every node can reach every other node by following the arrows around: ::: {#59e16e02 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") .add_edge("C", "A") ) # Returns True graph.is_strongly_connected() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` True ``` ::: ::: Adding a node that can only be reached one-way breaks strong connectivity, even though the rest of the graph is still tightly connected: ::: {#b0e33b28 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph.add_node(label="D") graph.add_edge("D", "A") # D can reach A, but nothing can reach D # Returns False graph.is_strongly_connected() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` False ``` ::: :::
